name: Meikko 5
source:
"All I want is to be his wife, be accepted by the family, and spend all our days together!"

I got in an accident and can't move my legs for 4 months. Thus begins my new life.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076857.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我只想成为他的妻子，得到家人的接纳，和他共度一生！”

我遭遇了事故，接下来的4个月里双腿都无法动弹。我的新生活就此开始。[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076857.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
